findings.current: The Doppelganger had already abandoned its contempt for Jin Taekyung, after witnessing countless deaths on the battlefield.
findings.defect: The Doppelganger experienced the deaths; it did not merely witness them.
findings.rationale: 무수한 죽음을 겪은 describes deaths the Doppelganger underwent.
findings.replacement: After dying countless times on the battlefield, the Doppelganger had long since abandoned its contempt for Jin Taekyung.
findings.source: 앞서 전장에서 무수한 죽음을 겪은 뒤, 진태경을 경시하던 마음을 이미 일찌감치 내버렸던 도플갱어다.

findings.current: Standing tall amid the Golems’ remains raining down around him, he gripped a silver spear glowing white above his head.
findings.defect: The draft places the spear above Jin’s head; the debris is what falls over his head.
findings.rationale: 머리 위로 쏟아지는 modifies the falling remains, not the spear.
findings.replacement: He stood tall, gripping a silver spear that glowed white as the Golems’ remains rained down over his head.
findings.source: 새하얗게 빛나는 은빛 창을 쥔 채 머리 위로 쏟아지는 골렘들의 잔해 사이에 우뚝 서 있는 그가.

findings.defect: The permanence of the threatened Erasure is omitted.
findings.rationale: 영원한 explicitly makes the loss permanent.

findings.current: The golden magical power that shone like sunlight was completely at odds with magical power, and it sliced through the flash.
findings.defect: The wording says magical power is at odds with itself instead of conveying how strange its sunlit radiance is for magic.
findings.rationale: The source contrasts the radiance of this magical power with what one would expect of magic.
findings.replacement: Golden magical power, bright as sunlight and strangely unlike magic, split the flash.
findings.source: 마력과는 도무지 어울리지 않는, 마치 햇빛처럼 환한 황금빛 마력이 섬광을 갈랐다.

findings.current:
As his master willed.

And as the voice that reached his master’s ear had commanded.
findings.defect: “His master” suggests the Skeleton King has a master whose ear receives the voice. The source refers to the sword’s wielder, the Skeleton King.
findings.rationale: 주인 is the wielder whose sword is moving; the subsequent commands reach the Skeleton King’s ears.
findings.replacement:
As the sword’s wielder willed.

And as the voice in his ear directed.
findings.source:
주인의 뜻대로.

그리고 주인의 귓가에 닿은 누군가의 목소리대로.

findings.current: That was exactly why the Doppelganger hadn’t gone out of its way to disable the Skeleton King.
findings.defect: This implies the Skeleton King had not already been disabled by the loss of his sight; the source says the Doppelganger did not take further action.
findings.rationale: 더 나서서 marks additional action beyond the blinding spell.
findings.replacement: That was exactly why the Doppelganger hadn’t bothered trying to disable the Skeleton King any further.
findings.source: 도플갱어가 굳이 더 나서서 스켈레톤 킹을 무력화시키지 않은 건 바로 그 때문이었다.

findings.current: It felt as if the Skeleton King had been possessed by a ghost.
findings.defect: The draft makes the Skeleton King the one seemingly possessed; the source describes the Doppelganger’s own bewildered feeling.
findings.rationale: 홀린 듯한 기분이었다 describes the viewpoint character’s feeling, not a condition afflicting the Skeleton King.
findings.replacement: The Doppelganger felt as though it had been bewitched by a ghost.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it changes who experienced the battlefield deaths, misplaces Jin’s spear, and loses several consequential or character-specific details.
